title: Drawer
description: A slide-out panel component supporting all four directions, swipe gestures, snap points, and focus trapping.

defaultOpen.description: Initial open state for uncontrolled usage.

onOpenChange.description: (open: boolean) => void — Callback when the drawer's open state changes.

zIndex.description: Z-index of the drawer overlay and panel.

direction.description: Direction from which the drawer slides in.

size.description: CSS size value for the drawer panel (width for left/right, height for top/bottom).

overlayBlur.description: Backdrop blur in pixels for the overlay.

lockScroll.description: Locks body scroll when the drawer is open.

closeOnOverlayClick.description: Closes the drawer when the overlay is clicked.

closeOnEscape.description: Closes the drawer when the Escape key is pressed.

classes.description: CSS class overrides for drawer sub-elements.

reduceMotion.description: Controls motion preferences. 'auto' respects OS setting.

trapFocus.description: Traps keyboard focus within the drawer.

restoreFocus.description: Restores focus to the previously focused element when the drawer closes.

portalContainer.description: HTMLElement | null — Portal container for the drawer.

initialFocus.description: RefObject<HTMLElement> — Element to receive focus when the drawer opens.

onTransitionEnd.description: (open: boolean) => void — Called when the open/close transition completes.

keepMounted.description: Keep the drawer DOM mounted when closed.

modal.description: Whether the drawer behaves as a modal dialog.

swipeThreshold.description: Minimum swipe distance in pixels to trigger close.

snapPoints.description: Array of snap point positions (0-1) for the drawer panel.

defaultSnapPointIndex.description: Initial snap point index for uncontrolled usage.

onSnapPointIndexChange.description: (index: number) => void — Called when the active snap point changes.
